name: Vanilla dungeon bosses are shown and treated as bosses
contract: Refs issue #6951. The vanilla dungeon bosses, including those summoned by encounters and events, are bosses (rank 3) in the db.exil.es creature table (SUB dump, 2026-10-04), which matches CoA's own creature query cache (hertigservices/ascension-data). The creature query response for each boss, and for its Heroic and Mythic templates, carries rank 3. Lower Blackrock Spire is covered by lbrs-boss-rank-6951.
